decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm’s existing dental thermoforming and custom-device manufacturing knowledge, so early results are interpretable and improvement is likely.
PETG thermoforming blanks are closely related to the firm’s core dental laboratory materials and manufacturing capabilities, supporting assimilation of feedback.
UV-curing lacquer leverages the firm’s in-house materials R&D, giving it enough related knowledge to learn from early results and improve the product.

Intraoral contrast spray is tied to the firm’s digital dental workflow strategy, and its existing digital solutions knowledge helps it evaluate and refine the product despite the chemical formulation stretch.
Custom earmolds draw on the firm’s existing custom-device manufacturing and hearing-care retail relationships, providing strong related knowledge to interpret early results.
Custom hearing protection earmolds similarly build on the firm’s earmold manufacturing expertise and hearing-market access, allowing it to assimilate feedback and keep improving them.
